name: @monkey-harness/pi-hermes-memory
description: pi facade for the shared Hermes-style memory system. All memory logic lives in @monkey-harness/hermes-memo-core; this package keeps only the pi plugin-interface glue: prompt injection plus memory/memory_search tool registration. Ported from pi-hermes-memo
